items.text: Edition 002 takes the last of Edition 001's four questions, what could continue, and tests one dependency four ways.
Edition 008 applies the same four verbs, Build, Carry, Control and Continue, to a single campaign.
The Dependency Explorer filters 41 career cases by ten kinds of dependency and shows which each case runs through.
For a longer self-check, the Ownership Index asks twenty questions across five areas and shows a five-area profile.
